title: Complex noun phrases
note: pre/post-modification, of-phrases, stacked NPs · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: The unexpectedly rapid growth of the market surprised investors.
items.cz: Neočekávaně rychlý růst trhu překvapil investory.
items.gap: The unexpectedly rapid ____ of the market surprised investors.
accepts: The unexpectedly rapid growth of the market surprised investors.

items.en: A recently published government report criticised the plan.
items.cz: Nedávno zveřejněná vládní zpráva plán kritizovala.
items.gap: A recently published government ____ criticised the plan.
accepts: A recently published government report criticised the plan.

items.en: The man in the corner with the blue coat is waiting.
items.cz: Muž v rohu v modrém kabátě čeká.
items.gap: The man in the corner with the blue coat ____ waiting.
accepts: The man in the corner with the blue coat is waiting.

items.en: Her decision to leave the company shocked colleagues.
items.cz: Její rozhodnutí opustit firmu šokovalo kolegy.
items.gap: Her decision ____ leave the company shocked colleagues.
accepts: Her decision to leave the company shocked colleagues.

items.en: The idea that money solves everything is false.
items.cz: Myšlenka, že peníze vše řeší, je falešná.
items.gap: The idea ____ money solves everything is false.
accepts: The idea that money solves everything is false.

items.en: Several highly experienced senior managers resigned.
items.cz: Několik velmi zkušených senior manažerů rezignovalo.
accepts: Several highly experienced senior managers resigned.

items.en: The collapse of the bridge over the river delayed traffic.
items.cz: Zhroucení mostu přes řeku zdrželo provoz.
items.gap: The collapse of the bridge over the river ____ traffic.
accepts: The collapse of the bridge over the river delayed traffic.

items.en: A small wooden box under the stairs held the keys.
items.cz: Malá dřevěná krabice pod schody držela klíče.
items.gap: A small wooden box under the stairs ____ the keys.
accepts: A small wooden box under the stairs held the keys.

items.en: Their failure to meet the deadline cost them the contract.
items.cz: Jejich neschopnost dodržet termín je stála smlouvu.
items.gap: Their failure ____ meet the deadline cost them the contract.
accepts: Their failure to meet the deadline cost them the contract.

items.en: The long-awaited results of the trial were published.
items.gap: The long-awaited results of the trial ____ published.
accepts: The long-awaited results of the trial were published.
